name: Fuji Michiko
source:
Born on April 29, 1989.
Member of the Kendo club. A girl with a gentle personality. She grew up in a strict family environment, and as such she has an old-fashion vernacular. Her nickname is "Fu-nyan." In addition to Kendo, she also enjoys calligraphy.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/3年B組金八先生_伝説の教壇に立て!]Wikipedia[/url]]
